prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: build-critical 16:9 landing-page hero raster for LumenLink
Input image: the approved composition reference establishes the restrained matte device language, deep ink and mint palette, and the clear screen-to-camera optical-transfer story; do not reproduce or rasterize its page UI, typography, controls, logos, or browser marks.
Primary request: Create a text-free, logo-free editorial technology scene showing a laptop screen optically sending a bright mint code beam directly into a nearby smartphone camera. The physical transfer path must be immediately obvious and technically plausible: the laptop display and the phone camera visibly face each other at close range.
Scene/backdrop: seamless matte deep ink #0B1512 environment with restrained tonal separation, no horizon clutter.
Subject: one open laptop and one upright smartphone on a minimal matte stand. The laptop display emits a disciplined flat field of abstract vertical optical-code bars; a focused mint #91DED4 beam travels directly from that display into the phone's rear camera lens. No readable interface content.
Style/medium: premium restrained editorial 3D/vector hybrid, smooth matte device silhouettes, precise proportions, subtle realistic depth, privacy-software clarity played straight; not photography and not sci-fi.
Composition/framing: exact 16:9 landscape, designed to crop cleanly at 1600x900. Keep the entire left third dark and nearly empty for semantic HTML headline and actions. Place the laptop and phone across the right two-thirds; use a clean side-on three-quarter view, with both devices fully inside frame and facing each other. Strong left-to-right optical path, ample edge breathing room.
Lighting/mood: soft controlled studio lighting, calm and trustworthy, with the mint beam as the only bright accent. Keep blacks matte and shadows restrained.
Color palette: deep ink #0B1512, mint #91DED4, charcoal and tiny off-white highlights only.
Materials/textures: smooth matte metal and glass surfaces without gloss spectacle; beam is bright but flat and geometric.
Text: none.
Constraints: no people, no hands, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no wordmarks, no browser branding, no UI labels, no invented claims. Preserve a genuinely empty left third.
Avoid: gradients, glassmorphism, neon cyberpunk, glowing room haze, lens flares, QR wallpaper, generic shield imagery, floating blobs, stock-photo styling, excessive reflections, fake app screens, extra devices, cables, clouds, network symbols, watermarks.
